0022600186.text: The LA Clippers (1-6, 1-2 at home) host the Miami Heat (2-5) in the Clippers' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, with LA on a six-game losing streak and 13th in the West. LA is without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Clippers lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 140-123 loss in Miami on December 1, 2025.
